column1: Biology padhne ka tarika kya tha?
column2:
Pehle YouTube se theory lectures dekhe, phir Arivihan app install kiya aur Suraj Sir aur Ankush Sir ke lectures follow kiye. Process tha:
Concept → NCERT → Objective Questions (NEET prep ke liye)

column1: : Mushkil biological names yaad kaise karte the?
column2: Jo names yaad nahi hote the, unhe apne room mein walls par chipka leta tha. Sone se pehle 2-3 baar repeat karta tha — jaldi yaad ho jaate the.

column1: Daily routine kya tha — khaaskar exam ke time?
column2:
7:30 AM — Uthna
9:30 AM — Padhna shuru (Physics pehle, kyunki brain fresh hota tha)
10:30–11 AM — First shift khatam
Lunch ke baad — Long session till 4:00–4:30 PM
4:30–6 PM — Bahar walk, thoda break
7:00–10:00 PM — Arivihan lectures + NEET prep
Raat mein — Din bhar jo padha uska revision

column1: Poore saal consistent rahe ya kabhi break bhi liya?
column2: Nahi, poore saal consistent nahi raha. Beech beech mein thak jaata tha. Kabhi kabhi hafte bhar ke lambe breaks bhi liye — but ekdum chodha nahi, thodi normal study continue rakhi taaki rhythm na toote.

column1: Physics kaisi lagti thi? PCB walon ko mushkil lagta hai na?
column2: Mujhe Physics zyada tough nahi lagti thi, concepts padhna accha lagta tha. Derivations aur theory YouTube se dekhke practice karta tha. Haan, numerical questions mein kabhi kabhi problem hoti thi — tab Arivihan ke Ask Doubt feature par upload ya type karke instant answer milta tha, kyunki raat mein teacher available nahi hote the.

column1: Subah ki shuruaat kaise karni chahiye?
column2: Subah 7:30 ke aas-paas uth jana chahiye aur 9:30 tak padhai shuru kar deni chahiye taaki pehla session 10:30-11 baje tak comfortably chal sake.

column1: Revision ke liye kaun si books use karni chahiye?
column2: NCERT book ko detail mein revise karna chahiye kyunki ye board aur competitive exams dono ke liye important hoti hai.

column1: Physical activity kaise include karein routine mein?
column2: Daily routine mein thoda bahar walk karna chahiye, jaise evening break ke time, taaki fresh feel karein.

column1: Kabhi motivation kam ho to kaise handle karein?
column2: Motivation kam hone par chhote breaks lein lekin padhai ko completely na chhod kar thoda continue rakhein.

column1: Daily kitne ghante padhai karni chahiye?
column2: Daily 3-4 ghante padhai ka ek session rakhna chahiye, jaise subah aur shaam ke sessions mein.
